strings.subtitle: — Fajlengero nasvalno —
strings.dnd_unavailable: O cirdipen thaj o mukipen nane. Keren buti le butonestar telal.
strings.shred_button: N A S V A L
strings.ssd_warning:
Dikh! Pa SSD, o ricipen upre nane garanto le nasvalimasko pal TRIM.
Kado programo si le HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
O fajlo "{name}" avla ricido upre thaj avla khoslo.

Jas maj dur?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.error_cannot_read:
Na mukha te genav o fajlo:
{err}
strings.report_title: ✅  O FAJLO RICIDO Upre THAJ KHOSLO
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS aver data-strea (ADS) nane kerde.
• O USN zhurnalo nane khoslo.
• Umbrakos kopii thaj cloudy synchronizacii
  (OneDrive th. a.) nane phangle.
strings.status_full: O obsah ricido upre pherdo le nula. Vricipen nane mukhlo — alatka dikhena samo nula.
strings.status_fast: O sero, o poopal thaj 4 MB patrin ricida upre. O aver nane phandlo, numaj pal o pharipena, o pherdo vricipen le klientengeri alatkenca nane mukhlo. Le garade dokumentenca keren buti le PUNO modo.
strings.status_empty: O fajlo sas shuko, o ricipen upre nane trobulo. Khoslo.
strings.error_permission: Na mukha te aresav o fajlo. Mužno si phandlo ande aver programo. Phand a thaj zumav pale.
strings.error_not_found: O fajlo nane arakhlo. Mužno si khoslo.
strings.error_is_symlink: Kado si simbolikano phandipen. O phandimata nane nasvalimata — o ciljno fajlo ačhela mishto.
strings.error_reparse: Kado si fajlo le thanestar (OneDrive vaj aver). Leskeri data si ande oblako, na ando disk — nane khanči te nasvali kothe.
strings.error_not_file: Kado naj fajlo (foldera vaj aver). Muk fajlo.
strings.error_hardlinks: Kado fajlo si aver phandimata ({n} sa). O phandimata naj len baro — sa anava si jednake. Te nasvalis pal o drom, data avla ricido upre thaj avla khindo kothe 32 byte, numaj o atino avla aresavlo pal aver phandimata. Khos sa phandimata prve.
strings.error_compressed:
O fajlo si kompresirime, enkriptirime vaj tanuko. Ricipen upre le nula naj garanto le nasvalimasko le purane data, ke NTFS ikerel len aver dromestar.

Ankhav o atributo: klik upral → Sifata → Barvale → ankh o kriko "Kompresi" thaj/vaj "Enkripti". Pale ker ŠHREDDER pale.
